name: Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds)
path: Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds), Jaipur, India
summary: Five-story pink and red sandstone palace with 953 honeycomb casements.
points: Built in 1799 CE by Maharaja Sawai Pratap Singh; designed by Lal Chand Ustad
Designed to allow royal court ladies to observe street festivals veiled from public view

name: Amer Fort & Sheesh Mahal
path: Amer Fort & Sheesh Mahal, Jaipur, India
summary: Majestic hilltop Rajput fort overlooking Maota Lake, famous for Hall of Mirrors.
points: Built in 1592 CE by Raja Man Singh I; expanded by Mirza Raja Jai Singh
Kachhwaha Rajput dynasty; UNESCO World Heritage Site (Hill Forts of Rajasthan)
Contains the world-famous Sheesh Mahal (Palace of Mirrors) decorated with convex Belgian glass foils

name: City Palace, Udaipur
summary: Colossal granite and marble palace complex on the banks of Lake Pichola.
points: Begun in 1559 CE by Maharana Udai Singh II after shifting capital from Chittorgarh
Constructed over 400 years by successive Maharanas blending Rajasthani and Mughal architectural styles
